scope: Comparative Gazebo 5c-2 basket-entry redesign only; no absolute physical-capacity claim and no 5c-3/5d

transferred_features: hood clear height scaled from old floor Z=25 mm to new floor Z=54 mm
front retention independent of the low floor-to-launch feed path

variants.high_hood: controlled-rise ramp to Z=92 mm plus covered high entry; roof clear plane approximately Z=160-178 mm
variants.one_way_flap: 80 g top-hinged 96x90 mm flap, joint range 0..70 deg opening only into the basket
variants.lip_cover: 16 mm fixed centre lip above basket floor plus light cover/cheeks; low ramp unchanged

delivery_matrix.preload_method: dynamic fall from identical deterministic low-discrepancy release points in the common unobstructed open-top region; no final grid placement

criteria.name: delivery_success_count
criteria.rationale: Every comparative condition must retain the new ball in all three deterministic repeats.

ranking_rule: Rank by number of fully passing conditions, then total successful delivery repeats, then fewer preload-spill runs, entrance-blocked runs and motion losses. Do not choose a convenient subset.
physics_limitations: Incoming ball ground/flywheel contact retains the unchanged calibrated tennis_ball_compliant law.
Basket, entry device and ball-to-ball contacts use uncalibrated native DART rigid contact; only relative comparison is claimed.
Passive flap hinge damping/friction are design assumptions, not measurements.
Absolute capacity and rebound retention require the P2-47 physical mock-up test.
